'''Adrián Rodrígues Gonçalves''' (born 14 August 1988) is an Andorran [[association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[Defender (association football)|right back]] for [[Atlètic Club d'Escaldes]] and the [[Andorra national football team]].

==Club career==

Rodrígues started his career playing for [[FC Andorra]] in the season 2007–08. In 2010, he signed a contract with [[CD Mensajero|Mensajero]] from the Spanish third division (fourth level). During season 2011–12 he played in different teams, playing for [[CD Huracán Z|Huracán Z]]. In 2012, he played for [[Racing Lermeño]].<ref name = "NFT">{{NFT player|pid=47793|access-date=3 August 2015}}</ref><ref>{{soccerway|adrian-rodrigues/128877|access-date=3 August 2015}}</ref> and the historical Spanish club [[Burgos CF|Burgos]].<ref>[http://www.tribunasalamanca.com/noticias/adrian-rodrigues-goncalves-ficha-por-el-salmantino/1391107858 Adrián Rodrigues Gonçalves ficha por el Salmantino]; Tribuna de Salamanca, 30 January 2013</ref>

After playing for [[CU Collado Villalba|Collado Villalba]] and [[CF Salmantino|Salmantino]],<ref name = "NFT"/> He signed for [[Marino de Luanco]] in January 2015 to play in the Spanish [[Segunda División B]] (third level).<ref>[http://www.futbolasturiano.es/noticias5/0091.htm Un defensa internacional para el Marino]; Fútbol asturiano, 29 January 2015</ref>

===International career===
Rodrígues represented the under 21-team Andorran team before his senior team debut for [[Andorra national football team|Andorra]] in 2012.<ref name = "NFT"/>
